summary: Very steep 11 m kerb on a residential road; too short and too sloped.

drivers.seclusion: Homes 16-17 m away on both sides; a dirt verge and trees on the east side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with cars parked on the west side; dirt verge on the east gives some room.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit 2P signs and a no-stopping sign mark this length; cars park along the road.

flags: Signs: no stopping at the north end
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the north end, open further south; shade mostly from the west and north.

best_section.where: east kerb of Harrys Road beside the dirt verge
